To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) liver biopsy remains essential to accurately evaluate the stage and grade of liver disease in patients with hepatitis C infection; (2) clinicians are unable to predict the grade and stage accurately despite knowledge of all available clinical and laboratory investigations; and (3) the results of our study support the current recommendations for liver biopsy in patients with hepatitis‐C infection.
